peer_protocol: fixed 320-position cache, functional full-cache update, full BF16 logit row copied to CPU, CPU argmax, eager attention for PyTorch
change_from_previous_affon_trace: Grouped attention removed exactly 64 index-select kernels per cached step, from 6769 to 6705; kernel time fell from 43.96 to 35.36 ms. Nsight spans are affected by tracing overhead and are not serving latency.
method: Nsight Systems CUDA SQLite activity; the final 15 cached windows each had an identical kernel-name sequence. Per-step kernel work sums kernel durations; between-kernel time is first-to-last span minus union of kernel intervals. CUDA launch API time is CPU call duration and overlaps GPU work. Affon host phase medians come from a separate run with temporary timers around executable.run, logits.to_array, finite_argmax, and old-cache disposal, using cached steps 3 through 15.
limitations: Affon uses an isolated CUDA snapshot with cuBLAS edits outside committed Compute main. Instrumented phase timings and Nsight timings come from separate runs; do not add them together. Kernel names are different between frameworks and do not establish one-to-one operator equivalence.
